## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      1 avis récent mentionne prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 3 sept. 2026 - 3 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Jose Maria Araque_, 3 sept. 2026, 1/5: "The app was good before, I paid for the single-time ad free version. Despite that they now blocked certain features that were free before behind a monthly paywall. Reply: yes, some exercises I was using in the past for free are now behind the subscription. I changed my phone and this features cant be transfert to the new one."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      1 avis récent mentionne bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 20 juil. 2026 - 12 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Evan Metcalfe_, 12 août 2026, 1/5: "This app was awesome, so much so that you didn't even mind the couple of ads it had because that meant the app was free. Buy some update must have happened because now I get the same ad for some other fitness app and even though there is a close button, no matter how many times I press it or wait or close and reopen the app, the ad does not close so this app is now completely unusable for me. I cannot even provide feedback in app as the ads start immediately on opening the app"
            2. _Joshua johnston_, 20 juil. 2026, 4/5: "the ads generated in the app will freeze the app itself. other than that the app is phenomenal. I do wish there were a few more unlocked exercises, but as a free app there's nothing missing. logging and generating exercise plans are great and the fact that I can regenerate a single exercise or all of them. 4.2/5"
<!--/ir-theme-->
